13:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Football
The No. 10 Texas Longhorns (6-2) visit No. 19 Missouri Tigers (6-2) at Memorial Stadium for an SEC matchup. Missouri beat Arkansas 34-10 behind two Austin Simmons touchdowns, while Texas seeks three straight wins after beating Mississippi State 31-3.

16:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The No. 23 South Carolina Gamecocks (5-3) host the Texas A&M Aggies at Williams-Brice Stadium. Texas A&M enters off a 31-20 loss to Alabama and relies on Marcel Reed, while South Carolina beat Oklahoma 42-25 behind LaNorris Sellers' three touchdowns.
